Parameters.QueryString: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yt_pipeline_silver_db.clean_raw_statistics WITH (format = 'PARQUET', parquet_compression = 'SNAPPY', external_location = 's3://yt-pipeline-akshath-silver-dev/youtube/clean_raw_statistics/', partitioned_by = ARRAY['region']) AS SELECT video_id, trending_date, title, channel_title, category_id, publish_time, tags, TRY(CAST(views AS bigint)) AS views, TRY(CAST(likes AS bigint)) AS likes, TRY(CAST(dislikes AS bigint)) AS dislikes, TRY(CAST(comment_count AS bigint)) AS comment_count, thumbnail_link, comments_disabled, ratings_disabled, video_error_or_removed, description, TRY(date_parse(trending_date, '%y.%d.%m')) AS trending_date_clean, region FROM yt_pipeline_bronze_db.raw_statistics WHERE video_id IS NOT NULL AND video_id != 'video_id';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yt_pipeline_gold_db.trending_category_analytics_v2 WITH (format = 'PARQUET', parquet_compression = 'SNAPPY', external_location = 's3://yt-pipeline-akshath-gold-dev/youtube/trending_category_analytics_v2/') AS WITH deduplicated_statistics AS (SELECT region, video_id, category_id, MAX(views) AS max_views, MAX(likes) AS max_likes, MAX(comment_count) AS max_comments FROM yt_pipeline_silver_db.clean_raw_statistics WHERE video_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region, video_id, category_id) SELECT s.region, COALESCE(r.category_title, 'Unknown') AS category_title, COUNT(DISTINCT s.video_id) AS total_unique_trending_videos, SUM(s.max_views) AS total_views, SUM(s.max_likes) AS total_likes, SUM(s.max_comments) AS total_comments, ROUND(AVG(s.max_views), 0) AS avg_views_per_video, ROUND((SUM(s.max_likes + s.max_comments) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(s.max_views), 0), 2) AS engagement_rate_pct FROM deduplicated_statistics s LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT category_id, region, category_title FROM yt_pipeline_silver_db.clean_reference_data) r ON s.category_id = r.category_id AND s.region = r.region GROUP BY s.region, COALESCE(r.category_title, 'Unknown');
